name: Ro Khanna
role: U.S. Representative for California's 17th district (Democrat, since 2017)
summary: Silicon Valley congressman who calls himself a progressive capitalist: Medicare for All, free college, a wealth tax on billionaires and industrial policy alongside strong antitrust and tech regulation. In foreign policy he favors restraint and congressional war powers, and has turned sharply critical of Israel's Gaza war while backing a two-state outcome.

universal-healthcare.rationale: States he supports a single-payer Medicare for All system and wants coverage for all Americans; reaffirmed it in 2025-26 interviews.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Backs raising the federal minimum wage to at least $17 an hour and co-sponsored the Raise the Wage Act of 2025.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Defends private property and free enterprise but argues unregulated capital flows hollow out communities and wants an active state role; evidence points both ways.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Campaigns for a wealth tax on roughly 900 billionaires and fairer taxation so revenue can fund healthcare, childcare and college.

unions-good.rationale: Supports union organizing (Starbucks letter, PRO Act) and says workers should get a larger share of profits.

property-fundamental.rationale: Says freedom rests on a right to private property, yet backs a wealth tax and offshoring penalties; mixed on how firmly it should be protected.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Says free enterprise without regulation destroys communities; founded the antitrust caucus and backs binding AI rules and the Stop WALMART/Stop BEZOS bills.

cut-welfare.rationale: Pledges to oppose cuts to Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid and defends nutrition assistance, tax credits and housing vouchers.

worker-ownership.rationale: Says 'we need employee ownership in this country' and co-sponsored the Reward Work Act (workers elect a third of boards); stops short of collective ownership of firms.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Wants Americans protected from warrantless data collection and unnecessary surveillance.

state-harmful.rationale: Argues government should play an important role in guaranteeing economic security; rejects a no-state view.

limit-guns.rationale: Supports universal background checks and voted for a federal assault weapons ban.

empower-police-military.rationale: Wants more funding for community policing and law enforcement, but opposes a 'bloated' Pentagon budget and Pentagon increases.

rehabilitation.rationale: His campaign positions favor alternatives to prison and reducing recidivism and mass incarceration.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Member of the LGBT Equality Caucus who says no one should face discrimination over orientation; tracker lists support for same-sex marriage.

abortion-legal.rationale: States he supports a woman's right to choose and calls himself fully supportive of reproductive rights, a decision for the woman and her doctor.

more-religion-public.rationale: Says the country needs spirituality and open religious argument in the public square, and that faith should inform politics.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Presents student debt cancellation as a way to close the racial wealth gap and condemns rollbacks of Black voting rights.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Backs legal status for Dreamers, family reunification and more visas, while wanting H-1B abuses curbed.

free-trade.rationale: Says the past decades' trade policy prioritized cheap goods at the cost of industrial communities and that the balance is wrong.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Calls the Libya intervention a mistake and says unilateral interventions are counterproductive.

open-borders.rationale: Says he has never believed in open borders and has always been for a secure border.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Calls for a renewable energy moonshot to tackle the climate crisis and supported the Green New Deal.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Lists nuclear energy with solar, wind and geothermal as part of the solution.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Supports strategic tariffs (steel dumping, heavy trucks) as part of industrial policy, but rejects blanket tariffs on allies and inputs.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Champions an industrial investment bank, patient capital and the CHIPS and Science Act to steer investment into strategic industries.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Describes America as a composite nation where anyone of any background is American through the Declaration and Constitution.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Says he favors equality of opportunity and that equal results would ignore individual initiative.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Champions tech jobs yet backs legislation to ban recursively self-improving AI until guardrails exist; mixed.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Warns against a dystopian AI future where predictive algorithms make decisions about people.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Criticizes threats to take Greenland and the 'might makes right' view, citing respect for self-determination.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Says Zionism is Jewish self-determination and Israel's right to exist, and envisions Israel as a secure Jewish democratic state beside Palestine.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Co-sponsored the Reward Work Act letting employees of listed companies elect one-third of the board.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Voted for large COVID relief and backs stimulus spending, but also unveiled a $12 trillion deficit reduction plan in 2025; mixed.

national-self-determination.rationale: Backs Jewish and Palestinian self-determination and cites respect for self-determination of peoples as an American value.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Argues faith and spirituality should deepen public life and move people, rather than reason alone.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Supports repealing fossil fuel subsidies and banning fracking on public lands; investigated oil industry disinformation.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Says politicians are indebted to corporations and that wealthy donors have bought politicians.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Says the Israeli government must face accountability for what he calls war crimes and urged prosecution of soldiers; also backed the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Advocates an extensive state role (single-payer care, childcare, free college, industrial policy), contrary to a defense-and-justice-only state.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Says no person should be discriminated against and calls for equal rights for all.

separated-powers.rationale: Invokes Madison and Jefferson's design, leads War Powers resolutions to check the president, and stresses congressional oversight.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Argues a multiracial, multi-faith democracy can be cohesive and that pluralism strengthens America, citing Douglass's 'composite nation'.

death-penalty.rationale: Campaign positions record opposition to capital punishment and a 2020 request to the Biden administration to abolish the federal death penalty.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Backs a two-state settlement on the Arab peace plan and an end to settlement outposts.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Says property rights are real but capitalism should not mean worship of capital at the expense of communities and workers.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Calls the occupation of Palestinians fundamentally unjust and led 74 lawmakers against West Bank annexation.

ban-cartels.rationale: Says Facebook should not have been allowed to absorb Instagram and WhatsApp and backs stronger antitrust enforcement; founded the House Antitrust Caucus.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Wants trade agreements to require wage and union standards abroad and to drop investor-dispute provisions that weaken labor and environmental protections.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Says helping those who start behind has been the affirmative action argument and that 'as far as it goes I think fine', a hedged defense.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Wants to end workplace discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Vows to protect Social Security's guarantees; a tracker of his campaign positions records opposition to diverting payroll tax into personal accounts.

corporate-influence.rationale: Refuses PAC and lobbyist money and says corporate money in politics must be removed.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Led a resolution condemning Holocaust distortion and another funding Holocaust education on campuses.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Member of the LGBT Equality Caucus working to end discrimination against LGBTQ+ people.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Supports trans rights, led legislation for an X passport marker, and says no one should be discriminated against over gender identity.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Sponsored a bill to combat Islamophobia and defends equal standing for non-Christian faiths.

social-market-economy.rationale: Calls his approach progressive capitalism: private enterprise combined with government standards, social protection and shared prosperity, likened to Catholic social thought.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Argues that wealth piled in a few hands and bought politicians threaten the country, and that tech billionaires should not decide the country's future.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Says he has never been for defunding the police and wants more police in his district while reforming profiling.

term-limits.rationale: Calls for term limits for the House, Senate and Supreme Court.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Cosponsored a resolution describing Israel's actions in Gaza as genocide and cites the UN finding.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Says people are not just material beings and have higher aspirations that politics should speak to.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Defends strikes after 9/11 but pushes restraint, congressional authorization and diplomacy over initiating military action.

free-public-college.rationale: Calls for free public college, community college and vocational school and co-sponsored the College for All Act.

future-generations.rationale: Says it is our responsibility to leave the planet healthy and safe for future generations.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Backs the PRO Act and union organizing and complains workers get too little of corporate profits.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Proposed a $1 trillion Earned Income Tax Credit expansion and lists earned income and child tax credits among programs he defends.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Describes himself as a vocal leader for cancelling student loan debt for working and middle-class borrowers.

voter-id.rationale: Says discriminatory voter ID laws are voter suppression and opposes any restrictions on voting.

women-suffrage.rationale: Says women are underrepresented in Congress and leadership and pledges to change that.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: His agenda stresses universal programs (Medicare for All, universal pre-K and childcare, free college) rather than poverty-only targeting.

financial-transactions-tax.rationale: Proposed financing a $1 trillion Earned Income Tax Credit expansion with a financial transaction tax.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: Promotes 'economic patriotism': rebuilding domestic production and good jobs for working people.

notes: Living person: no inference; answers only where he spoke or acted on the specific statement. Books (Entrepreneurial Nation, Dignity in a Digital Age, Progressive Capitalism) were not reachable as full text. Israel positions shifted after October 2023 (earlier self-described pro-Israel progressive); the most recent statements are used. Wealth-tax and Gaza genocide positions come from 2025-26.
